thread:
alex_support: FYI customer AcmeCo hitting repeated 403s on inference POST. customer supplied request_id=req_7b9a2f1c and curl repro. Can someone do a server-side log lookup? first seen ~2026-03-15 16:02 UTC.

alex_support: curl they used:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-XXXX" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-neo-2","input":"hello"}'
```

alex_support: observed response body: `\{"error\":\{"type\":\"forbidden\",\"message\":\"API key not allowed for model\"\}\}`

maya_oncall: putting oncall eyes. which region/endpoint did they use? any customer id or account id so we can filter?

alex_support: region eu-west-1, acct_id=acme-001, request_id=req_7b9a2f1c. They said it started after a billing update yesterday.

ivan_inginfra: running a quick Kibana/KQL search. try this to reproduce server-side: `request_id:"req_7b9a2f1c" or metadata.account_id: "acme-001"`

ivan_inginfra: KQL I used (hot nodes):
```kql
service:api AND request_id:req_7b9a2f1c OR (account_id:acme-001 AND status:403)
| sort @timestamp desc
```

maya_oncall: heads-up retention: hot logs kept 14 days, cold archived for 90 days. if the event rolled to cold we need the archive job which takes ~30m to surface.

support-bot: :information_source: Log retention policy: hot=14d, cold-archive=90d. Archive lookup ticket created #ARCH-1122.

ivan_inginfra: I found entries on edge-proxy in eu-west-1 around ts=2790001080-2790001100. snippet:
```
[edge] ts=2026-03-15T16:01:20Z req=req_7b9a2f1c method=POST path=/v1/generate status=403 reason=policy_denied model=gpt-neo-2 acct=acme-001 token_id=tok_rollexp
[auth] ts=2026-03-15T16:01:20Z req=req_7b9a2f1c decision=deny reason=token_plan_mismatch allowed_models=[gpt-small,gpt-embed]
```

ivan_inginfra: short version: token_id mapped to a plan that doesn't permit gpt-neo-2. looks like a billing/plan change removed model entitlement.

alex_support: ok that matches the customer message about billing update. Can we confirm whether their key was rotated to a read-only key or downgraded?

maya_oncall: checking billing service now. @ivan_inginfra if you can pull the account plan snapshot at 2026-03-15T15:58 UTC that'd help.

ivan_inginfra: pulled snapshot: acct acme-001 plan changed from Pro->Starter at 2026-03-15T15:55 UTC via billing job id=bill_5533. Starter doesn't include gpt-neo-2.

customer-success-liz: I've DM'd the customer to confirm they requested the downgrade; they say they authorized a seat reduction but didn't expect model access to change immediately.

alex_support: next steps for support: let customer know this is an entitlement issue and provide either temp workaround or suggest model switch to a supported smaller model. suggested customer-facing curl to test with gpt-small:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-XXXX" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-small","input":"hello"}'
```

maya_oncall: if they want immediate access to gpt-neo-2 we can request a billing rollback or create a temporary entitlement for 1 hour. I'll open BILL-ROLLBACK-499 and sync with finance.

ivan_inginfra: note for SRE: for future hunts you can search for `auth.reason:token_plan_mismatch AND request_id:req_7b9a2f1c` to find correlated traces. if logs age out, use the archive ticket.

alex_support: I'll share repro steps and the edge log snippet with the customer. also requesting a debug bundle if they still see 403 after switching to gpt-small. ask them to include the exact time and the request_id.

customer-success-liz: customer replied: tested gpt-small -> 200 OK. they accepted workaround and will discuss plan with finance. :thumbsup:

alex_support: great. closing loop: root cause = billing plan downgrade removing model entitlement; server-side auth denied at token validation step. Archive ticket left open in case they need historical traces.

maya_oncall: marking as resolved on support side. recommend adding a config flag on billing side to email account owners when model entitlements change (follow-up with product).

support-bot: :white_check_mark: Thread resolved by alex_support on 2026-03-15T16:19Z (2790001190).
